description: Remove a link (Verknuepfung) by its link_id from list_links – meant for leftovers on the pasteboard (Montageflaeche), graphics anchored in overset text and other orphans that no page shows, not as a second delete_frame. remove_frame (default true) removes the holding frame with the graphic (an anchored frame takes its anchor character with it); false removes only the graphic and leaves the empty frame. dry_run true only reports what would be removed. When the object lies on a document page or a parent page, or is anchored in visible text, the call is refused with invalid_state and details.code "link_on_page" unless allow_on_page is true. Linked story files (InCopy) are refused with details.code "story_link"; objects on locked layers, locked objects and anchors in stories that are not checked out here (lock_state) are refused like in delete_frame. Returns removed_link_id, removed_frame_ids (like delete_frame: the frame first, then the page items inside it – InDesign counts the placed graphic), location_before {location, page_id, page_name, spread_id, container_id, container_type, graphic_type, story_id, in_overset}, links_before and links_after; with dry_run would_remove_link_id and would_remove_frame_ids instead (nothing changes). No undo through this tool – run dry_run first.

allow_on_page.description: Also remove when the object lies on a document page, a parent page or is anchored in visible text (default false: refused).

document_id.description: Document to act on, from list_documents or open_document. Without it the frontmost document is used. A document opened with show_window false is never the active one and must always be addressed by id.

dry_run.description: Only report what would be removed (default false).

remove_frame.description: Remove the holding frame too (default true); false removes only the graphic.

name: delete_link
title: Remove a leftover link
